== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Chall Bekan, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 2 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of January 1, 2013” (PDF made 16 April 2013): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf source], preserved copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Chall Bekan (PC Errata 2013 slip)]].
